# Marilla Cuthbert

## Overview

- **Age:** Eighty-five years old (by Volume 5)  <sub>[v5 c2 P6](../source/v05-c02.md#nw-v05-c02-p0006)</sub>
- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v1 c1 P13](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0013)</sub>
- **Status:** Alive  <sub>[v5 c2 P6](../source/v05-c02.md#nw-v05-c02-p0006)</sub>
- **Role:** Homemaker and farmer at Green Gables  <sub>[v1 c1 P8](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0008), [v1 c1 P9](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0009), [v1 c6 P36](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0036)</sub>

## Appearance

Marilla is a tall, thin woman with angular features and sharp lines. In her earlier years, her dark hair showed gray streaks and was pulled back into a hard knot secured with two aggressive wire hairpins. By her late eighties, her hair has turned snow-white. Though she initially struggled with severe eye strain and bad headaches, her eyesight paradoxically improved as she grew older.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P13](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0013), [v1 c27 P42](../source/v01-c27.md#nw-v01-c27-p0042), [v3 c22 P2](../source/v03-c22.md#nw-v03-c22-p0002), [v5 c2 P6](../source/v05-c02.md#nw-v05-c02-p0006)_

## Personality

Marilla is a woman of rigid conscience, narrow experience, and practical sense. Reserved and undemonstrative, she initially mistrusts frivolity or excessive imagination and rarely displays deep emotion openly. Over the years, however, her temper and crispness soften into a warmer, mellower nature. Deep down she possesses a subtle sense of humor and a fierce, loyal love for her adopted daughter Anne.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P9](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0009), [v1 c1 P13](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0013), [v1 c30 P3](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0003), [v1 c38 P45](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0045), [v1 c38 P46](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0046), [v3 c7 P16](../source/v03-c07.md#nw-v03-c07-p0016), [v3 c22 P2](../source/v03-c22.md#nw-v03-c22-p0002)_

- Strict and precise  <sub>[v1 c1 P8](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0008), [v1 c1 P13](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0013)</sub>

## Abilities

- Skilled at housekeeping and needlework  <sub>[v1 c1 P8](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0008), [v1 c1 P9](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0009), [v1 c14 P55](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0055)</sub>

## Goals

- Raise Anne properly and provide her with a good home  <sub>[v1 c6 P31](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0031), [v1 c7 P29](../source/v01-c07.md#nw-v01-c07-p0029), [v1 c8 P7](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0007), [v1 c19 P89](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0089)</sub>

## History

Marilla lived at Green Gables with her shy brother Matthew in quiet routine until they decided to adopt an orphan boy to help on the farm. By a misunderstanding, Mrs. Spencer instead brought back an eleven-year-old girl, Anne Shirley. Though Marilla intended to return Anne to the asylum, Matthew's gentle pleading and her own reluctance to hand the sensitive child over to the harsh Mrs. Blewett led Marilla to keep her. Over time, Marilla's strict discipline gave way to deep maternal affection as she raised Anne through her school days and Queen's Academy studies. Following Matthew's sudden death from heart failure and facing a threat to her own failing sight, Marilla planned to sell Green Gables until Anne sacrificed her college scholarship to stay home and teach in Avonlea. Later, Marilla invited the widowed Rachel Lynde to move in with her and adopted the young orphaned Keith twins, Davy and Dora. Years later, she rejoiced when Anne married Gilbert Blythe, reflecting that it set right an old mistake of her own youth.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P20](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0020), [v1 c3 P1](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0001), [v1 c6 P18](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0018), [v1 c6 P19](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0019), [v1 c6 P31](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0031), [v1 c30 P3](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0003), [v1 c37 P11](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0011), [v1 c38 P12](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0012), [v2 c22 P22](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0022), [v2 c26 P28](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0028), [v4 c2 P8](../source/v04-c02.md#nw-v04-c02-p0008)_

## Background by volume

- Was stung in childhood by an aunt calling her a 'dark, homely little thing'  <sub>[v1 c9 P44](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0044)</sub>
- Had a seafaring uncle who gave her mother an amethyst brooch  <sub>[v1 c13 P20](../source/v01-c13.md#nw-v01-c13-p0020)</sub>
- In her youth, let willful pride come between her and Gilbert Blythe's father  <sub>[v4 c2 P8](../source/v04-c02.md#nw-v04-c02-p0008)</sub>
